Done means Incremental and idempotent: `unisphere prep --target DIR` over explicit or default roots publishes tables atomically. A re-run with nothing changed reads zero body bytes and writes zero rows. Appended sources contribute only records after the committed cursor. Replaced, truncated, or same-size rewritten sources start a new generation and the canonical views never contain rows from a superseded generation. A crash mid-run leaves the previous publication intact and the next run recovers without duplicates. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0001); A versioned, documented table contract: schema version, per-source adapter policy version, generation semantics and canonical views are specified; an external engine reads the published Parquet without per-engine schema declarations. A compaction command rewrites the current generation and removes superseded parts without changing any view result. (../plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0008).
